summary: Iteration 26 (Driver Planning + Passenger Booking Wizard + Responsive) — BOTH backend and frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest (100%) after a bug-fix in server.py reminder_loop (see rca_of_issue). Endpoints/behaviours verified: (1) POST /api/rides with scheduled_at + business=true succeeds for passager@test.com (linked to Acme Conseil company) and returns scheduled_at + business; (2) POST /api/rides for an immediate private ride (scheduled_at null, business false) succeeds; (3) POST /api/rides/{id}/accept as chauffeur@test.com after clearing docs_blocked + assigned_driver_id works and the ride appears in GET /api/driver/planning with scheduled_at/pickup/dropoff/price and correct ascending sort by scheduled_at; (4) reminder_loop multi-step reminders now fire — a driver notification of type 'reminder' with title starting 'Rappel course · dans 5 min' was created within 65s for a ride scheduled ~4 min ahead, ride.driver_reminders_sent was persisted, and re-polling 40s later returned exactly 1 matching 5-min reminder (no duplicate). Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844): logging in as passager@test.com immediately shows the full-screen overlay [data-testid=booking-wizard] BEFORE any destination entry. Step 1 shows Type de course with wizard-type-private + wizard-type-business, and the Professionnelle option shows 'Facturée à Acme Conseil'. Tapping wizard-continue reveals Step 2 Réservation with wizard-when-now + wizard-when-scheduled; tapping wizard-when-scheduled reveals wizard-datetime chips. Choosing wizard-when-now + wizard-continue dismisses the wizard, the destination search view appears, and selecting a POPULAR place opens the trip view where wizard-summary is present (chips 'Privée' + 'Immédiate' + pencil), a vehicle list renders and confirm-ride-button is visible; tapping wizard-summary re-opens the wizard. Driver: chauffeur@test.com sees tab-planning in the bottom bar; tapping it shows driver-planning with header 'Planning', renders planning-empty when no scheduled rides, and renders planning-ride-<id> cards with time/countdown/passenger/price/pickup/dropoff/tags when an accepted scheduled ride exists. Responsive (1280x800): booking-wizard card measured 560px wide, centered (left=360, right=920) — not stretched. After completing the wizard the passenger bottom sheet also stays centered (search input width ≈452px inside a ~640px sheet centered at ~ x=360-920). No React Native red-screens, no HTML/CSS misuse detected in these components.

minor.issue: Multi-step reminder path failed silently because pymongo returns naive scheduled_at while now_utc() is aware; subtraction raised 'can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' every minute, blocking all 'Rappel course' notifications. FIXED in /app/backend/server.py by promoting sched to timezone.utc before subtraction. Consider the same guard for any other Python-side datetime math on Mongo-fetched timestamps.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: audit other loops (e.g., compliance_loop) or places in rides.py that compute deltas from Mongo-fetched datetimes to ensure they also handle naive-vs-aware timestamps.
Optional: in BookingWizard.tsx add testID='wizard-back' behavioural test coverage (already present in code, not exercised here) — main agent may want a QA scenario going back from step 2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reminder_loop lines ~78-90: naive datetime returned by pymongo required guarding — fix applied. Longer-term: convert stored datetimes to aware on read via a serializer, or set tz_aware=True on the Mongo client so aware datetimes come back directly.
routes/driver.py driver_planning uses status ∈ {accepted, in_progress} and requires scheduled_at != None — this correctly excludes 'requested' offers awaiting acceptance. Good.

BookingWizard.tsx line 148: maxWidth: 640, alignSelf: 'center' correctly constrains the card on wide screens. Good.

Backend timezone fix in server.py must remain in place.
rca_of_issue: Bug found & fixed: server.py reminder_loop's multi-step section did `mu = (r['scheduled_at'] - now).total_seconds()/60`. now_utc() is timezone-aware but pymongo returns Mongo BSON dates as naive Python datetimes, so subtraction raised TypeError 'can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' on every loop iteration. The FIRST reminder path (single 45-min 'Course programmée') worked because it uses only Mongo-side $gte/$lte on `now`, not Python subtraction, so notifications for that path fired normally — which is why the bug had been invisible. Reproduction: schedule a ride ~4 min ahead, accept it as driver, wait 60s → no 'Rappel course' notification is created and backend log emits WARNING reminders: reminder loop error: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Fix: import timezone, and before subtraction do `if sched.tzinfo is None: sched = sched.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`. Verified by re-running test_iteration26_planning_wizard.py::TestDriverReminders which now passes and observing backend log 'Push (non envoyé, clé non configurée) -> [driver_id]: Rappel course · dans 5 min'.
